scope: Saved-array development diagnostic of original-source support versus old/conservative target support; no synthesis, registration, rendering, model execution or threshold selection

observations.preprotocol_schema_inspection: One previously audited old correspondence NPZ was opened only to list array names/shapes/dtypes; original report metadata was also inspected. No original atlas/target support intersection or new joint counts were computed

inputs.reports: Hash-pinned existing source reset, UV support correspondence, old registration and conservative registration reports
inputs.binary: Exactly their selected three original RGBA atlases, 24 target samples NPZ and 12 target-own correspondence NPZ; shared identical binary paths are deduplicated
inputs.code: Freeze this protocol, new CLI/tests and every imported project helper before actual joined-count evaluation; schema-only preflight exposure is disclosed separately
inputs.budget: Per-file bounded snapshots and bounded NPZ expansion, strict names/dtypes/shapes and no pickle; pin all selected descendants before execution and recheck before successful publication
inputs.scope_excluded: Do not read model weights, raw photographs, generated full images, GLBs or holdout age/identity results

validation: All 12 sample/source/condition mappings must agree across the two registration reports and correspondence report; preserve unknown API source_age

Compare original report source_frame and shared UV hash/origin/grid metadata for every paired target; old/conservative sample gltf_uv arrays and hashes agree and bind the source metadata. Target projection/ROI metadata remains its own and identical between variants; no GLB or original projection is recomputed
RGBA arrays are uint8 256x256x4 with binary alpha and RGBA zero where unknown; target coverage equals alpha and class sampled

Correspondence rows/columns are unique, in bounds and equal the saved old classification>=2 domain point by point. Retain the prior UV diagnostic's unique-owned domain label and region semantics; do not rerasterize UV/topology or independently reprove geometry in this saved-array diagnostic
Old target classification/global and regional counts must match the old UV diagnostic; conservative changes must not alter common UV or correspondence region membership
Counts are descriptive support availability, not clean-skin labels: original observed texels can include glasses, occluders and lighting

accounting.known: Exact alpha255 in an existing original atlas or registered target array, never inferred from color
accounting.regions: all 65536 atlas texels; unique correspondence domain; target-own saved eye_36_41, eye_42_47, nose_27_35, mouth_48_67 regions
accounting.overlap: The four anatomical boxes can overlap and must never be summed into a new disjoint face denominator
accounting.reason_partition: For every region and joint state, retain all seven mutually exclusive target classification counts; these sum to the state count, state counts sum to region requested count
accounting.fractions: source_only/source_known and source_only/region_count with null for zero denominators; do not average target-dependent denominators without reporting them
accounting.delta: Conservative minus old integer counts per state/region/reason, with the expected class5-to-class6 increase distinguished from original source support
accounting.interpretation: Source-only counts identify previously observed source locations absent in the target, not permission to copy source colors, establish causal NO_FACE explanations or certify identity/age quality

output: Create a fresh ignored output/research directory containing JSON counts, deltas, pins and integrity only; no PNG, color array, modified mask/atlas or GLB
policy: Existing no-fill protocols remain unchanged. Original-source fallback would require a separately authorized, explicit mixed-provenance design and cannot be introduced as a target-observation repair in this diagnostic
